purpose: The product's top bar: the rail's collapse control, the breadcrumb trail, and the notification and profile menus. Built on the SDK's TopNav.

useInstead.when: you want a bar with no design-system dependency
you need a toolbar scoped to one page's content
useInstead.use: your own — this bar is application chrome and sits above every page

decision.authority: This guard is the authority for the iosense top bar.
decision.beforeTheRules: This bar owns the control that collapses the RAIL. That is deliberate: a control which hides a panel cannot live inside that panel, because collapsed there are 48px and nowhere to put it.

rules.if: you are wiring the collapse toggle
rules.then: pass `isPinned` and `onTogglePin` from the same state the rail reads
rules.because: one piece of state drives both; duplicating it is how the bar and the rail end up disagreeing about whether the panel is open

rules.if: the viewport is below the mobile breakpoint
rules.because: the same button changes job — it opens the drawer rather than pinning the rail — and its label and glyph have to describe whichever it currently does

rules.if: an ancestor in the trail is a SECTION with no page of its own
rules.then: omit its href so the crumb renders as inert text
rules.because: the alternatives are both worse: a crumb with no handler is a tabbable control that does nothing, and pointing it at the section's first child moves the reader SIDEWAYS into a sibling when the crumb's whole job is to go up

rules.then: put the current page last and give it no href
rules.because: the last crumb is rendered as the current page and is the only one carrying aria-current

rules.if: you need a control in the top bar
rules.because: it renders to the LEFT of the bell and the avatar, so adding one never shifts the two fixed ones

constraints: The application launcher and the assistant button are NOT part of this package — see antiPatterns.
`isSticky` is left at the SDK default, which is what pins the bar.
The bar's left padding is zeroed by theme-overrides.css so the leading glyph sits 8px inside the bar, matching the avatar's inset on the right.

accessibility.keyboard: The collapse toggle is the first control in the bar. Both menus open on click, close on Escape and on outside click, and return focus to their trigger.
accessibility.aria: <header> landmark. The toggle carries aria-expanded and an aria-controls pointing at the rail. The trail is a labelled Breadcrumb landmark with exactly one aria-current="page".
accessibility.notes: Crumbs without an href are rendered as text, not as disabled buttons — a disabled control still announces itself as a control that could have worked.

composition.childrenContract: None. Content arrives through `trail`, `actions`, and the notification/profile props.
composition.notes: Rendered in the SDK AppShell's own `topNav` slot, above the content sheet.

antiPatterns.dont: Re-adding the application launcher or the assistant button
antiPatterns.why: both are product surfaces rather than chrome — one opens an assistant this package knows nothing about, the other lists applications only the host can enumerate. They were removed from the export on purpose

antiPatterns.dont: Giving a section crumb the href of its first child
antiPatterns.why: a crumb goes UP; sending the reader to a sibling is a different action wearing the same clothes

antiPatterns.dont: Putting the rail's collapse button inside the rail
antiPatterns.why: collapsed the rail is 48px wide, so the button would have to be duplicated somewhere reachable

antiPatterns.dont: Holding a second copy of the pinned state in the bar
antiPatterns.why: two copies drift, and the bar then describes a state the rail is not in

examples.canonical:
<AppTopBar
  trail={[{ label: 'Workflows' }, { label: 'All Workflows', href: '/workflows' }, { label: 'Workflow runs' }]}
  onNavigate={setActiveId}
  profile={profile}
  preference={preference}
  onPreferenceChange={setPreference}
  notifications={notifications}
  unreadCount={unread}
  onOpenNotifications={() => setActiveId('notifications')}
  isPinned={isPinned}
  onTogglePin={togglePin}
  isMobile={isMobile}
  isNavDrawerOpen={drawerOpen}
/>

incorrect.why: Workflows is a section with no page; pointing it at All Workflows moves the reader sideways instead of up
the launcher was deliberately removed from this package; if the host has one, it supplies it — but it is not chrome
